description:
About the job

Customer Support Specialist 




Location: Colombia / Mexico (Remote) 

Position Type: Full-Time 

Vacancy Status: This posting is for an existing vacancy.




About Us

Voices is the trusted voice partner for brands, tech and voice talent. Voices helps scale real voice solutions, across traditional voiceover, Voice AI, and ethically sourced voice data. For more than two decades, the biggest and most beloved brands have trusted Voices to find their voices and bring their projects to life.

Why join us? We’re on a mission to shape the future of voice, and we’re building a team that’s curious, collaborative, and passionate about making great ideas heard.




About the Role 

As a Customer Support Specialist within our Delivery & Operations department, you will be on the front lines providing a stellar, high-touch experience to our diverse community, from Voice Over Talent to Enterprise clients. This role is unique because it blends proactive customer problem-solving with platform integrity; you'll not only resolve inquiries but also act as a platform guardian by reviewing jobs and investigating suspicious activity to ensure trust and safety. Working in a fast-paced environment, you'll leverage tools like Salesforce, Slack, and AI-powered support tech to tag cases, log bugs, and provide front-line insights that shape our product. You will report directly to the Manager, Customer Support.




Responsibilities 

In this role, you’ll take ownership of the following key areas:

Triage and Resolve: Prioritize and answer urgent cases, calls, and emails across multiple channels. Solve immediate customer challenges while proactively heading off future problems.
Trust and Safety: Review jobs and packages to ensure legitimate postings are approved. Investigate suspicious users and execute steps to remove fraudulent accounts from the platform.
Data and Insights: Tag 100% of your assigned cases with accurate dispositions, types, and sentiment to provide data-driven insights. Actively log bugs for the IT team.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as a subject matter expert and educational resource. Attend interdepartmental meetings to share front-line insights regarding core customer challenges.
Process Improvement: Embrace available tools and technology to recommend and execute efficiency improvements in interdepartmental Customer Support workflows.




What You Bring

We’re looking for someone who brings some or all of the following:

Experience & Education: A minimum of a College diploma in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration (or equivalent), plus demonstrated experience in an advanced Customer Support role or related field.
Language Skills: Must be fluent in English. Additionally, high proficiency or native-level skills in Spanish is required.
Technical Proficiency: Familiarity with Salesforce, Slack, and Google Suite. Experience with AI-powered support tools (including chatbots) and productivity platforms is a strong asset.
Exceptional Soft Skills: Top-tier time management, agility, and the ability to juggle competing priorities with grace in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Customer-First Mindset: A passion for delivering high-touch customer service by listening, empathizing, and anticipating needs. You excel at analyzing complex issues and collaboratively developing innovative solutions.




Perks & Benefits

In addition to competitive compensation, we offer a range of perks that support your growth, wellbeing, and day-to-day flexibility. Here’s what you can look forward to: 

Generous Vacation
Comprehensive Health Coverage
Performance Bonus Program
Learning & Development Support
A Great Team




Remote Work Details: We champion workplace flexibility. This role is remote, but we still highly value in-person connection. You are always welcome to work from our Ontario hub, though it is never required. Should we ever need you to attend a specific event, we will fully cover your travel and lodging expenses.

 

Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with location & experience.




Additional Notes

All interviewed candidates will receive notification within 45 days of final interviews.
Our Use of AI in Recruitment: We use an AI tool in our applicant tracking system (Jobvite) to check how well a candidate’s experience aligns with the job requirements. This feature, called Talent Match, may label an application as a match or leave it unlabelled. It does not make decisions or reject candidates. Every application is reviewed by our People Operations team.




Our Commitment to Equity & Accessibility

Voices is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible workplace. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences.

If you require accommodation during the recruitment process, please let us know, and we will work with you to meet your needs.

 




Apply Online

If this sounds like a role where you’d thrive, we’d love to hear from you. Interested candidates are encouraged to send their cover letter and résumé by completing the online application. By doing so, your resume is guaranteed to be reviewed.

description:
About the job

Who We Are

GrowthAssistant connects top marketing and operations talent with fast-growing companies that depend on great execution to scale. Founded in 2021 and named by Forbes as one of the best startups to work at, we're a permanently remote team that runs on integrity, proactive candor, and a bias toward action — and we prioritize the human experience in everything we do. We hire for skill and for heart, and we invest in our people for the long haul.




The Opportunity

We are looking for a detail-oriented Lifecycle Marketing Specialist to join a high-growth brand and take ownership of end-to-end email campaign operations. In this role, you won't just be executing tasks; you’ll be a key driver of the lifecycle process—managing the content calendar, drafting creative briefs, and collaborating with brand and design teams to bring campaigns to life.




Operating primarily within Iterable, you will build, QA, and deploy sophisticated automated journeys and weekly campaigns designed to drive lead conversion, member engagement, and reactivation. If you are a proactive marketer who balances technical execution with strong project management and a data-driven mindset, we want to meet you.




What Your Day-to-Day Will Look Like

Campaign Operations: Build, QA, and deploy 3-4 weekly email campaigns in Iterable, focusing on audience segmentation, triggered sends, and automated journeys.
Calendar & Project Management: Manage the email content calendar using Jira to ensure all campaigns, briefs, and stakeholder approvals remain on schedule.
Creative Collaboration: Write creative briefs and partner with designers and copywriters to ensure all assets align with email marketing best practices.
Technical Execution: Build and edit templates using Stripo and use basic HTML to troubleshoot formatting issues within Iterable.
Performance Optimization: Conduct A/B testing and pull performance data to report on open rates, CTR, and conversion metrics, providing actionable recommendations for strategy.
Database Health: Maintain strict list hygiene, segmentation accuracy, and deliverability standards while ensuring full privacy compliance.
Process Growth: Assist in building new automated workflows and triggered campaigns from the ground up as the lifecycle program scales.




What You Bring

Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience in lifecycle, CRM, or email marketing, preferably within a high-growth startup environment.
Platform Expertise: Strong experience with Iterable (preferred) or Braze. Proficiency in HubSpot or Klaviyo will be considered if you have deep automation and journey-building experience.
Strategic Mindset: A deep understanding of segmentation logic, customer lifecycle stages, and triggered campaign operations.
Content Coordination: Proven ability to manage creative briefs and coordinate timelines across internal brand and creative teams.
Technical Skills: Experience with email builders (Stripo, Taxi, or Stensul) and basic HTML for template editing.
Data Literacy: Ability to interpret email metrics and translate data into performance-improving strategies.
Communication: Excellent communication skills regarding timelines, blockers, and creative feedback.
Logistics: Ability to work US business hours and maintain high QA standards in a fast-paced environment.




Bonus Points if:

You have direct experience in healthcare, wellness, or membership-based brands.
You are an expert-level user of Stripo and Iterable.
You have familiarity with Power BI, SQL, or advanced reporting workflows.
You have experience providing creative feedback based on engagement data.
You have exposure to SMS or omnichannel strategy (a future need for this role).




What We Offer

At GrowthAssistant, you aren't just joining a company; you're joining a movement to redefine how the world’s best brands scale. We believe that the right talent, placed in the right role, changes everything - and that starts with how we take care of you.




We support your life inside and outside of work with a comprehensive benefits package:

Fully Remote: 100% Remote work environment, never fight traffic again
Health Coverage: HMO or Healthcare Stipend (depending on location) after 90 days of service
Time to Recharge: 7 Paid Holidays and up to 6 PTO days per year
Family First: Parental leave after 1 year of service




We offer additional incentives for go-getters and proven performers!

$25 monthly perfect attendance bonus
Performance bonus
Anniversary bonus ($100 at 1 year; $200 at 2 years)
Earn a $300 referral bonus for each candidate you refer who is successfully hired, and $500 when you help us identify and close a new opportunity with your client




Your Application Roadmap

You’ve applied, now let’s get to work. Here’s the play-by-play:

Step 1 Resume Screening: Our hiring team reviews your experience to see how your unique skills align with our high-growth roles.
Step 2 Recruiter Interview: If we believe we have a great client match, we’ll reach out to schedule a human-to-human chat to discuss your career goals, experience, and what makes you tick.
Step 3 Online Assessment: This is your chance to shine! You’ll complete a role-specific test, a personality assessment, and your official GA Profile Form so we can represent you.

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

As Stripe’s user base and global footprint grow dramatically, we have distinctly unique support problems resulting from both our type of scale and the type of businesses we partner with. The Stripe Delivery Center (SDC) strategy will provide operational leverage and expand Stripe’s portfolio of operational capabilities to support the scaled needs of external users and internal Stripe teams.

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and support where every team member’s voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

What you’ll do

As an analyst on the Payments Health Operations team, you will be charged with monitoring and maintaining payments performance for Stripe’s largest users. This will include triaging, investigating, and responding to detected regressions in authentication and cost rates; providing in-depth analysis of performance degradations; answering queries from our product support and technical account management teams; and engaging with users and other teams at Stripe to help ensure our users are maximizing their acceptance rates while minimizing their costs and fraud.

You will work at the core of Stripe's platform, ensuring the reliability of our payments stack and the health of the broader ecosystem. Technical Operations roles in Payments are a dynamic and key component of Stripe's success. Focused on financial partner integrations and funds-flow expansion, we sit at the intersection of product/platform engineers and financial partners, connecting them to ensure that everyone thrives and nothing is lost in translation.

Responsibilities


Monitor authorization rates and performance for large users, responding to alerts of degradation, triaging and investigating the cause, and communicating your findings to the account team, banking partners, and card networks.
Analyze cost checkers to ensure our cost models' accuracy.
Respond to performance inquiries from technical account managers, product support teams, and other internal Stripe teams.
Interface with Stripe’s financial partners across the world to communicate operational breakages and help drive resolutions.
Provide fast, accurate responses to complex support inquiries from partners.
Partner with internal and external teams to validate the accuracy of Stripe’s financial data.
Introduce data and process efficiencies to meet the scale and speed of Stripe.
Identify and automate inefficient operational processes to reduce manual workloads.



Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


Have at least 1 year of experience in a technical role, with experience writing SQL queries to query relational databases.
Have experience navigating the nuanced complexity of financial systems and solving large-scale, technical challenges.
Have strong analytical skills to investigate, prioritize, and identify the root cause of issues.
Have experience managing communications and workflows with technical and non-technical teams across internal and external stakeholders.
Are comfortable operating independently and thrive in a fast-paced environment to deliver results, with an ability to establish priorities and reliably execute against time-sensitive deadlines.
Have experience identifying and triaging technical issues.
Possess a demonstrated track record of process improvement and proactive problem-solving.
Have excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Spanish.



Preferred Qualifications


Payments expertise (working with financial partners, optimizing processing errors, managing payment costs).
Experience operating in a high-growth technology company.
Python or Scala knowledge.



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

About the job

Great companies don’t grow because they post more content. They grow because the right people notice them.




Every day, potential clients are scrolling, searching, and deciding who they trust.




The challenge isn't getting attention—it's turning attention into conversations, opportunities, and growth.




That's why we're looking for a Marketing & Growth Coordinator who can help us expand our reach, strengthen our brand presence, and create meaningful connections with future clients.




This is a hands-on, execution-focused role that combines content creation, audience growth, outbound marketing, prospect engagement, and first-touch client communication. You'll play a direct role in helping us generate inbound and outbound opportunities while supporting the growth of our business pipeline.




If you're someone who enjoys turning ideas into action, creating engaging content, building relationships, and helping businesses grow, we'd love to meet you.




What You'll Do

Drive Marketing & Growth Initiatives

Develop and execute marketing initiatives designed to attract new clients and increase company visibility.
Support pipeline growth through outbound campaigns, targeted outreach, and brand awareness efforts.
Identify and engage industries, markets, and niches aligned with company growth goals.
Help generate inbound business opportunities through consistent and strategic marketing efforts.
Contribute directly to company growth by creating opportunities that lead to new client conversations.




Build and Grow Our Social Presence

Manage and maintain company social media platforms, including LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and other relevant channels.
Create and publish high-quality content that showcases company activity, hiring successes, operational updates, and client outcomes.
Develop a consistent flow of written, visual, and video-based content.
Monitor engagement, interact with audiences when needed, and maintain an active online presence.
Help strengthen brand awareness and position the company as a trusted partner in the marketplace.




Execute Outbound & Inbound Marketing Efforts

Launch and manage outbound email and messaging campaigns tied to hiring activity, target industries, and company initiatives.
Build, organize, and maintain prospect outreach lists.
Handle inbound marketing inquiries and serve as the first point of contact for prospective clients.
Conduct first-touch discovery calls with potential clients.
Communicate professionally and confidently with U.S.-based business owners and decision-makers.




Create Content That Supports Growth

Develop marketing materials, including presentations, one-pagers, branded collateral, and other business development assets.
Coordinate simple video editing and content formatting.
Support company branding initiatives and ensure consistency across all platforms and materials.
Assist with branded materials, promotional items, and company marketing assets when needed.
Help tell the company's story through content that attracts, engages, and converts prospects.




Collaborate Across the Organization

Work closely with leadership and internal teams to align marketing efforts with company goals and priorities.
Gather updates, success stories, wins, and content from internal departments.
Support company-wide growth initiatives through consistent execution and follow-through.
Help ensure marketing efforts remain aligned with business objectives and growth targets.




What You Bring

Proven experience in marketing, social media management, outbound marketing, lead generation, or related fields.
Demonstrated success growing audiences, increasing engagement, generating leads, or supporting business development efforts.
Ability to showcase previous campaigns, audience growth results, content performance, or measurable marketing outcomes.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Confidence speaking with U.S.-based business owners and decision-makers.
Experience handling inbound inquiries and conducting initial prospect conversations.
Experience creating content across multiple platforms and formats.
Familiarity with social media management and outbound email marketing.
Basic video editing and content formatting skills are preferred.
Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and execute independently.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where initiative and follow-through matter.




Why This Role Matters

Every marketing campaign, social post, outreach message, and prospect conversation creates an opportunity for growth.

In this role, you'll help shape how our company is seen, how new clients discover us, and how opportunities enter our pipeline. Your work will directly contribute to brand visibility, lead generation, client engagement, and long-term business growth.




If you're excited about combining marketing, content creation, outreach, and relationship-building into a role where your work creates measurable impact, we'd love to hear from you.

About the job

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Open Role: Marketing Associate 

Marketers at Canonical are brand stewards and demand creators.They transform complex open-source technology into messages, stories and strategies that shape the market understanding of our vision. Some focus on differentiated product and portfolio positioning; others specialize in account-based engagement, partner and alliance messaging, or product-led growth. Whatever their specialization, each marketer works as part of a cross-functional unit, contributing campaigns and insights that help the company learn and grow faster.

We have a bias for action, focus efforts on the most impactful activities and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works.

Marketers at Canonical don’t just promote open source; they amplify it, ensuring our innovations reach the right people, at the right time, with clarity and purpose from developers to decision makers.

As a Marketing Associate , you won't just be watching from the sidelines; you will be hands-on from day one, collaborating with cross-functional teams to translate complex technical innovations into compelling market value.

Location: This role will be based remote globally

What Your Day Will Look Like


GTM Support: Contribute to go-to-market planning and execution. 
Storytelling: Draft and edit compelling messaging and positioning that highlights business value for diverse target audiences. 
Campaign Coordination: Assist in developing campaign plans and content dissemination strategies to ensure our message reaches the right people. 
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with other demand generation and digital teams to help optimize marketing funnels and track campaign performance. 
Event & Social Support: Work with the wider marketing team to coordinate webinars, events, and social media promotions. 



What We Are Looking For In You


Tech Curiosity: A genuine passion for technology and a desire to learn about open source. 
Analytical Thinking: An ability to break down complex issues and translate them into clear, actionable recommendations. 
Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships within a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. 
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills; you enjoy storytelling and creating impactful content. 
Proactive Mindset: A self-starter who can prioritize tasks effectively and meet deadlines in a dynamic setting. 
Foundational Knowledge: A basic understanding of marketing principles or go-to-market strategies (via your degree, internships, or personal projects). 
Growth Mindset: Someone who is eager to learn, open to feedback, and not afraid to take on new challenges. 



What We Offer You

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.

Background in inbound sales or upselling
Familiarity with CRM systems and call management tools
Experience working with U.S.-based companies or customers

description:
About the job

Description

Amazon Ads helps brands create experiences that delight customers and deliver meaningful results. With 300+ million worldwide active customer accounts, and first-party insights based on shopping, streaming and browsing signals, brands can craft relevant campaigns that enhance customer experiences. Our solutions on Amazon.com, services like Twitch, IMDb T V, Alexa, Amazon Music, and partnerships with third-party publishers and exchanges make Amazon Ads the ultimate amplifier for brands to reach the right audiences in the right places, both on and off Amazon.

We’re looking for a results-oriented Account Manager who is passionate about partnering with our advertisers to make effective, analytically driven marketing decisions. As an Account Manager, you will manage and deliver against difficult advertiser goals and problems to drive revenue and exceed revenue targets. You nurture customer relationships, identify/close revenue driving actions and develop your client’s portfolio. Additionally, you will be able to leverage Amazon’s proprietary data to provide strategic and personalized campaign recommendations to meet your customer’s business goals. This role is highly collaborative, working with Creative, Sales, Product and Retail partners. The Account Manager’s strategic digital expertise is considered critical to unlocking greater value and impact for our advertisers.

Key Responsibilities


 Use knowledge of Amazon Advertising full-funnel ad products and measurement to craft tailored proposals for customers.
 Hit or exceed revenue targets for assigned book of business.
 Achieve assigned non-revenue business objectives and goals.
 Own all facets of the account management process for medium to large accounts, and develop strategic relationships with key points of contact.
 In partnership with the account team, develop annual brand and media strategies that map to customer objectives.
 Use first-party and third-party insights to build pre-flight, in-flight, and post-flight campaign-level recommendations that lead to revenue outcomes or increased customer satisfaction.
 Advocate for customers internally, and utilize internal resources, to drive customer success.
 Educate advertisers on performance metrics, category trends/approaches, and consumer insights using existing and/or customized insights.


Basic Qualifications


 Bachelor's degree in Economics, Marketing, Advertising, Statistics, Engineering, or Business
 Experience in digital advertising and client facing roles
 Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers
 Experience with annual brand and media planning
 Experience with Excel


Preferred Qualifications


 Master of Business Administration
 Experience in display advertisement industry
 Experience in omni-channel marketing, search engine marketing or search engine optimization
 Experience in programmatic strategy and implementation


Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. About the job

About us:

At Near, we help top talent in Latin America find remote roles with US companies. Our mission is to create better lives by fostering a remote work culture that transcends borders.




About the role

We're revitalizing our outbound sales strategy and need someone hungry, resourceful, and AI-savvy to own this critical function. You'll implement proven projects already designed by our marketing/sales team, then have the freedom to optimize and develop new approaches as you demonstrate success.

This is a unique opportunity for a smart, driven individual who is curious and self-taught on AI to make a significant impact working directly with our founding team. We value execution and results over years of experience.




What You'll Do

Implement and execute two established outbound projects, ensuring consistent delivery and optimization.
Build and maintain systematic processes that deliver predictable results.
Prepare and manage cold outreach campaigns, including writing and refining email sequences - using AI to draft, test, and iterate faster
Measure and continuously improve outreach campaign performance to drive sales pipeline growth.
Leverage AI tools to research prospects, personalize outreach at scale, and automate repetitive tasks.
Identify new opportunities, tools, and approaches to enhance our outreach processes - with a strong eye toward AI-native solutions.
Collaborate closely with marketing to optimize strategy and nurture cold leads into marketing and sales-qualified opportunities.
Provide accurate performance reporting to the C-level management team.
Work directly with the founding team on all outbound initiatives.

A fast learner who works autonomously.

Hungry to make an impact in a fast-paced startup environment.
Tech-savvy and eager to learn new tools.
Someone who thinks quickly, identifies issues proactively, and implements solutions.




Tech Stack & Tools

AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and similar) for research, copywriting, and workflow automation.

Excel intermdio

· Mantener contacto con Planners de Wilson US (Team Sports planners) en el caso de Órdenes de Compra Domesticas para solicitar producto.

· Mantener contacto con el departamento de compras para el proceso, seguimiento y embarques para las órdenes de compra.

· Verificación de Precios y/o Costos en PICK al ingresar órdenes de compra.

description:
About the job

Job Title: Digital Ad Buyer & Quality Control

Location: Remote (Latin America)

Work Hours: Full-Time

Compensation: $2,500–$3,000 USD/month




About The Role

We are seeking a highly detailed and hands-on Digital Ad Buyer & Quality Control specialist to support our performance marketing team. Our client is a boutique digital marketing agency that prioritizes substance over fluff, maintaining a close, high-impact relationship with a limited roster of premium clients across music, entertainment, media, and tech.

This role is structured in phases: initially, your primary focus will be performing meticulous quality checks and reporting across paid marketing, email, and SMS campaigns. Within a month, you will transition into independently planning, setting up, and launching ad campaigns across multiple platforms. If you are an incredibly organized stickler for detail who loves a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.




Key Responsibilities

Quality Assurance: Quality check campaign execution by the advertising team, catching errors in setup, targeting, copy, creative, event dates, locations, and more.
Communications & Tracking: Monitor and respond to pertinent email communications between clients and external teams.
Campaign Execution: Build, launch, and manage end-to-end paid ad campaigns without assistance across Meta and TikTok (and ideally Google).
Strategy & Reporting: Create strategic and budget recommendations for campaigns and develop regular reports with actionable insights for clients.
Project Management: Ensure meeting action items are carefully noted, assigned, and tracked in ClickUp to ensure timely execution.




Must-Have Qualifications

Experience: 3+ years of experience building and managing ad campaigns, with deep expertise in the nuances of the Meta ads platform at a micro level, alongside experience in TikTok and Google Ads.
Project Management Tools: Proficiency using in-depth project management platforms such as ClickUp, Asana, or similar software.
Extreme Attention to Detail: Absolute zero-tolerance for typos, inaccurate information, or mismatched event details (such as dates, venues, or lineups).
Communication Skills: Proactive internal and external communication skills with fluent English proficiency.
Team Fit: Experience working closely with a small, fast-paced team while remaining highly organized with your own tasks, priorities, and calendar.




Nice-to-Have Qualifications

Experience working with ticketed live events, a passion for music, or strong taste in the space.
Hands-on technical experience with tracking pixels (generation, installation, conversion events, and custom audience creation).
Proficiency with Google Analytics to monitor client traffic trends.
Experience drafting and executing email or SMS marketing campaigns using platforms like Mailchimp, Klaviyo, Laylo, Hive, or Community.
Foundational SEO optimization skills across client web domains.




Why Work With Us?

Join a boutique, fast-paced team where your work directly moves the needle for high-quality clients.
Escape the corporate fluff—we focus on meaningful campaigns, proactive insights, and real results that keep clients partnering with us for years.
Opportunity to rapidly expand your operational responsibilities from quality control into full campaign ownership.

About the job

We are one of the fastest-growing private youth sports operators in the GTA and Florida. We delivery high-quality, structured sports programming across multiple locations, with a focus on fun, skills development, and exceptional customer experiences.

This is an entry-level role for someone who has foundational knowledge of email or digital marketing and wants to develop deep expertise in lifecycle campaigns, automation, and data-driven optimization. You will work side by side with the Director of Marketing, building real skills in platforms like Twilio and SendGrid while contributing to campaigns that directly impact customer acquisition and retention.

If you are analytical, curious, detail-oriented, and excited about how data and messaging come together to drive results — we want to meet you.

WHY JOIN US

We are a growing company in the sports industry, and our marketing team is at the core of our expansion. This role is an opportunity to go beyond sending emails — you will learn the strategy, the technology, and the data behind lifecycle marketing at a company that moves fast and values results.


Mentorship from experienced marketers and direct access to senior leadership
Hands-on work with enterprise platforms (Twilio, SendGrid) from day one
A culture that rewards curiosity, precision, and ownership
Flexible remote or hybrid work arrangement
A real growth path toward a full Lifecycle Marketing Specialist or Marketing Analyst role


Key Responsibilities

Campaign Execution & Support


Assist in building, scheduling, QAing, and launching email and SMS campaigns using Twilio and SendGrid under senior supervision
Help set up and QA automated lifecycle flows including onboarding sequences, re-engagement campaigns, retention triggers, and other lifecycle marketing initiatives
Support the management of audience lists, segmentation criteria, suppression files, and workflow documentation
Assist in preparing and formatting email templates in collaboration with the design team
Coordinate campaign timelines, internal deliverables, and marketing calendars to ensure campaigns launch on schedule
Maintain organized libraries of marketing assets, templates, and campaign documentation


Testing & Performance Tracking


Support A/B test setup and help document results for subject lines, CTAs, and content variants
Assist with campaign testing, tracking, and reporting across email and SMS channels
Compile and maintain performance reports tracking key metrics including open rates, click-through rates, conversions, engagement, and unsubscribes
Assist in identifying trends in campaign data and flagging opportunities for optimization and process improvements


Compliance & Operations


Help ensure all campaigns comply with applicable regulations including CASL, CAN-SPAM, and GDPR
Assist with list hygiene tasks including managing bounces, opt-outs, and suppression lists
Maintain documentation of campaign workflows, platform settings, operational processes, and process guides
Support ongoing improvements to marketing processes and operational workflows


Collaboration


Work closely with the Director of Marketing and senior team members to align on campaign priorities and goals

Comfortable working with data and digital tools; not afraid of dashboards or spreadsheets
Strong attention to detail: you notice what others miss and take quality seriously
Great written communication skills in English
Eagerness to learn marketing platforms and grow into a technical marketing role
Fluency in English (written and spoken). Spanish is a strong asset


Preferred Skills & Experience


Any hands-on experience with an email platform (Mailchimp, HubSpot, Klaviyo, SendGrid, or similar)
Exposure to SMS marketing or basic understanding of how SMS campaigns work
Familiarity with A/B testing concepts
Basic HTML knowledge or willingness to learn email templating
Studies or coursework in marketing, communications, business, or related fields
Any experience in digital, tech, or startup environments


Benefits

Compensation: $800-1200 USD p/m

About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

As a BC (Business Campaign) Campaign Strategy Intern at DiDi, you will support the design, execution, and performance analysis of marketing and activation campaigns that drive driver and rider acquisition, retention, and platform engagement across multiple regions. Your work will directly contribute to measurable increases in user activation rates, cost-per-acquisition improvement, and campaign ROI while helping the campaign strategy team scale targeted programs across DiDi’s large, multi-product ecosystem.

In this role, you'll be...


Analyze campaign performance data and generate weekly dashboards and insights that identify trends, anomalies, and optimization opportunities, contributing to a 10–20% improvement in campaign KPIs.
Support the planning and execution of cross-channel acquisition and retention campaigns (in-app, push, SMS, paid social), coordinating with product, operations, and creative teams to ensure timely launches and consistent messaging.
Build and maintain audience segmentation and targeting logic using customer and driver behavioral data to improve precision targeting and lift conversion rates by testing new segment strategies.
Develop A/B test plans and track results for creative, channel mix, and incentive structures, documenting learnings and recommending scalable changes to reduce CPA and increase LTV.
Prepare concise business-facing reports and presentation decks that translate campaign findings into actionable recommendations for regional managers and senior stakeholders.
Monitor campaign budget spend and pacing, flagging risks and proposing reallocation strategies to maximize ROI while ensuring compliance with local market guidelines.
Assist in local market research and competitive benchmarking to adapt global campaign frameworks to regional behaviors and regulatory constraints, ensuring relevance and compliance.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


Last years of bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field is preferred.
Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience using Excel, SQL, or analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Looker, Tableau) to manipulate datasets and derive actionable insights.
Proactive, collaborative attitude with experience working in cross-functional teams and the adaptability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
Attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership, able to manage campaign tracking, budget pacing, and documentation for multiple regional pilots concurrently.



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

description:
About the job

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Open Role: Graduate Partner Marketing Manager

Marketers at Canonical are brand stewards and demand creators.They transform complex open-source technology into messages, stories and strategies that shape the market understanding of our vision. Some focus on differentiated product and portfolio positioning; others specialize in account-based engagement, partner and alliance messaging, or product-led growth. Whatever their specialization, each marketer works as part of a cross-functional unit, contributing campaigns and insights that help the company learn and grow faster.

We have a bias for action, focus efforts on the most impactful activities and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works.

Marketers at Canonical don’t just promote open source; they amplify it, ensuring our innovations reach the right people, at the right time, with clarity and purpose from developers to decision makers.

As a Graduate Partner Marketing Manager, you aren’t just running campaigns; you are architecting the strategic relationships that drive our business forward. You will collaborate with the titans of tech:


Public cloud: AWS, Google, Microsoft, Oracle.
Silicon: NVIDIA, Intel, Arm, Qualcomm, AMD.
Global hardware: Dell, HP, Lenovo.



Early careers & growth

We are specifically looking for recent graduates who are serious about their success and ready to make a global impact. At Canonical, we prioritize talent and potential over years of experience; we will teach you the technical and commercial nuances of the open-source world through our structured career journey program. You will gain experience working with top tier talent and with multiple enterprise technologies. If you have the drive and a high standard for excellence, we provide the platform for you to become a world-class marketing leader.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the Americas region and will report to the Partner Marketing Team Manager.

Your impact

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and support where every team member’s voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities


Troubleshoot and solve external user issues 
Analyze our processes and instigate changes to help scale our operations and improve user experience 
Work closely with other Stripe teams to improve our product offerings and messaging around new products and features 
Gain unique insights into how thousands of businesses on Stripe scale and operate 
Have an opportunity to learn how Stripe operates from the ground up and make a real impact on the future of the organization 
Be a part of building a brand-new team and operational culture for Stripe 
Partner with global operations specialists or business process owners to run a critical workflow



Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


You have a user-first mindset and are energized by the challenge of solving difficult problems
You have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
You excel in critical thinking and problem solving
You have prior experience in customer service or internal and external user-facing operations
You enjoy learning about technical products and processes, you're an organized, self-starter with passion for finding solutions to our user’s challenges
You have a process-oriented mindset and the ability to get things done
You enjoy working in an in-office environment with strong cross-team collaboration and support
You prioritize well and enjoy working in a quick-moving environment
You are humble and have a proven track record for working well across teams and with external partners
You're willing to periodically work a weekend day for which you'll receive a weekday off. The SDC operates during daytime hours with shifts from the morning through early evening



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience or knowledge in user support 
Prior experience working on projects or process improvement initiatives 



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

About the job

Role: E-commerce Simulation Expert (Remote)
Location: Remote (Work from Anywhere)
Payout: $40 - $50/hour




Role Overview:

We are hiring for one of our clients, seeking an E-commerce Simulation Expert to work on a contract basis. The role focuses on building and refining synthetic e-commerce environments that train and evaluate advanced AI models. Your expertise in real-world commerce will directly shape how AI systems learn, reason, and perform across critical domains. This work supports the development of reliable AI agents and contributes to the evolution of human-in-the-loop AI training.




Key Responsibilities:

• Design and construct synthetic digital stores with realistic product assortments, logical category structures, and authentic pricing models to reflect real-world e-commerce complexity.

• Generate, structure, and maintain comprehensive product catalogs ensuring high data quality, logical consistency, and alignment with market standards.

• Develop diverse shopping scenarios and user prompts that simulate varied consumer intents, preferences, and challenging edge cases to stress-test AI behavior.

• Create evaluation rubrics and conduct rigorous quality assurance to ensure generated data and simulations meet domain-specific accuracy and realism requirements.

• Collaborate with AI teams to refine prompt engineering and scenario design for continuous improvement of AI training datasets.




Required Skills & Qualifications:

• Demonstrated experience in e-commerce operations, including product data management, catalog structuring, or retail systems with a focus on data integrity and real-world relevance.

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills to design complex, logically consistent product hierarchies and pricing logic.

• Familiarity with AI/LLM prompting and evaluation principles, or ability to quickly learn how to structure inputs that generate high-quality training data for AI systems.

• Background in scenario design and user behavior modeling, preferably in retail, consumer goods, or related domains.

• Attention to detail and a quality assurance mindset to maintain high standards in synthetic data generation and simulation environments.

• Self-directed work style with ability to manage multiple asynchronous tasks and deliver consistent, high-quality output under defined deadlines.




More About the Opportunity:

This role offers the chance to contribute directly to the development of frontier AI systems by leveraging real-world e-commerce expertise. You will work within a global network supporting AI research, with exposure to cutting-edge reinforcement learning environments and agent-based AI training. The position is ideal for professionals seeking meaningful impact through applied domain knowledge in a rapidly evolving field.

description:
About the job

Brainlabs is the media agency built to answer one question: what's actually driving profit? Founded in 2012 by Daniel Gilbert, we were built by engineers before we were a media agency. Today, 1,000+ Brainlabbers across five continents use our proprietary agents, built on 32 media tools and over 2,500 logged experiments, to help brands connect every channel they plan and buy to one thing: the bottom line.

The role

Brands live and die by their product pages. A great product with poor content gets buried. A well-optimized listing with clear titles, strong keywords, and accurate attributes climbs. This role

owns that gap.

As a Content Optimization and Catalogue Management Specialist, you'll be responsible for how our clients products show up, get found, and convert on Amazon and Mercado Libre. That means writing and refining listings, managing catalogue health, and building the kind of organic visibility that doesn't disappear the moment ad spend drops.

You'll work directly with client teams and internal strategists to keep catalogues clean, content sharp, and rankings moving in the right direction.

What will you do?

Your day-to-day breaks into two connected areas.

Content Optimization

Content optimization is where you drive organic performance. You'll conduct keyword research, write and update product titles, bullet points, descriptions, and backend attributes. You'll audit existing content against platform best practices and identify gaps before they become ranking problems. You'll test copy variations and track what actually moves the needle.

Catalogue Management

Catalogue management is where you keep the operation running. You'll handle the publication and maintenance of product listings, manage bulk uploads and flat files, resolve listing errors

and suppressed ASINs or items, and keep content synchronized across multiple accounts and categories. When something breaks, you figure out why and fix it.

Beyond those two pillars, you'll monitor organic ranking performance, report on content health metrics, and bring recommendations that are grounded in data, not guesswork.

What are we looking for?

Experience

Around three years working in content optimization and/or catalogue management on Amazon and/or Mercado Libre. You understand how these platforms rank organic results and you've

influenced those rankings for real brands.

Platform Fluency

You know Seller Central and Vendor Central. You've worked with Mercado Libre item publication flows. Flat files, bulk uploads, listing errors, and suppressed items are familiar

territory, not new concepts.

Keyword and SEO Fundamentals

You know how to research, prioritize, and place keywords in a way that platforms reward. You understand the difference between what drives impressions and what drives conversions.

Analytical Mindset

You read performance data and draw conclusions from it. If organic rankings drop, you have a process for diagnosing why. If a content change works, you can explain what it did and why it helped.

Attention to Detail

Catalogue work is unforgiving. A wrong attribute, a missing image, a misformatted file: these things cause real problems. You catch errors before they ship.

English Proficiency

You're comfortable reading, writing, and communicating professionally in English. You'll work with international teams and documentation.

Nice to Have


Experience with tools like Helium 10, Data Dive, or Jungle Scout.
Familiarity with Amazon's A+ Content and Brand Store modules.
Experience across multiple categories or markets.



What happens next?

We know searching for a job is tough and that you want to find the best career and employer for you. We also want to ensure that this position is the best fit for both you and us. Therefore, you will participate in a comprehensive interview process that includes skills interviews with our team. The goal of this process is to allow you to get to know us as we learn more about you.

Brainlabs actively seeks and encourages applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds and identities. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace: we are committed to equal opportunity for all applicants and employees regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion, or belief, and marriage and civil partnerships. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the application process, please let us know!

Please note that we will never ask you to transfer cash or make any other payment to us in order to apply for a role or to work for Brainlabs. Any such asks are fraudulent and should be reported to the appropriate authorities in your area.

About the job

Hi there! We are South and our client is looking for a Google Ads / PPC Specialist!

Note To Applicants


Eligibility: This position is open to candidates residing in Latin America. 
Application Language: Please submit your CV in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered. 
Professional Presentation: We encourage you to showcase your professional experience by including a Loom video in the application form. While this is optional, candidates who provide a video presentation will be given priority. 
Interview Policy: The use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools during interviews are strictly prohibited. 
Note: As part of the final stages of our hiring process, candidates may be asked to provide professional references for a reference check. If hired, you may also be asked to update your LinkedIn profile :)


The Role

We’re hiring a hands-on Google Ads / PPC Specialist focused on lead generation through paid search. The goal is simple: turn high-intent searches into phone calls and booked appointments, not clicks or impressions.

This is not e-commerce or ROAS optimization on product catalogs. Success here means driving lower cost per lead, higher lead volume, and stronger lead quality across home services and local service industries such as HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, and healthcare.

You’ll own your accounts end to end — from audits and campaign builds to optimization, scaling, and performance storytelling. You’ll collaborate closely with a copywriter (ads), a web/UX team (landing pages), and account managers (client context and communication).

What You’ll Own


Audit, build, manage, and scale Google Ads campaigns (Search, Local Services Ads / Google Guaranteed, Performance Max, 
Display, and remarketing) across multiple accounts
Improve performance by reducing cost per lead while increasing lead volume and quality
Manage keyword strategy, including match types, search term analysis, negative keywords, and continuous optimization to eliminate wasted spend
Own conversion tracking integrity using GA4, Google Tag Manager, and call tracking tools (e.g., CallRail or similar), ensuring accuracy before optimization
Close the loop with CRM data by feeding qualified leads and booked jobs back into Google Ads via offline conversion imports
Manage bidding strategies and budget allocation to maximize lead efficiency
Align landing pages with ad intent to improve conversion rates (in collaboration with web/UX teams)
Continuously test ad copy, landing pages, bidding strategies, and audiences
Report performance clearly to stakeholders and proactively flag risks or performance shifts
Use AI tools daily to accelerate analysis, reporting, and optimization workflows


The Hard Parts (Read Before Applying)


We prefer candidates self-selecting out if the environment is not a fit:
Lead generation is different from e-commerce. This role focuses on lead quality, not purchase ROAS. Interpreting lead quality requires deeper judgment than transaction-based metrics
Full ownership role. You will both execute campaigns and own outcomes — there is no separate team running accounts for you
Multiple accounts, fast pace. You’ll manage several clients simultaneously, each with different seasonality patterns and performance dynamics
Client communication under pressure. You’ll handle questions when lead volume fluctuates or costs rise, and must be able to explain performance clearly and calmly
Tracking accuracy is critical. Incorrect tracking invalidates all optimization work — validation is a core responsibility


How You’ll Be Measured


Cost per lead (CPL) — reduction and stability across accounts
Lead volume and quality — increased number of qualified leads (calls, booked appointments, form fills)
Client retention — accounts remain due to consistent performance
Account health — clean structure, accurate tracking, proper negatives, and well-documented changes


Who You Are

This role is a strong fit if you:


Have 3+ years of experience managing Google Ads / paid search with measurable results
Can independently audit accounts and prioritize fixes with clarity
Have scaled budgets while maintaining cost-per-lead targets
Have deep expertise in Search campaigns (match types, search term mining, negatives, bidding strategies)
Have experience with Local Services Ads (Google Guaranteed), including setup, optimization, and lead dispute handling
Have implemented and managed conversion tracking (GA4, GTM, call tracking) independently
Have experience feeding offline CRM conversions back into Google Ads (closed-loop attribution)
Are highly data-driven and continuously testing new approaches
Communicate performance clearly and confidently in client-facing settings
Use AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT or similar) as part of your daily workflow
Are fluent in professional English and comfortable working with U.S.-based teams and clients


Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9 AM – 5 PM U.S. Central Time.

Compensation: USD salary

Location: 100% remote opportunity

If this opportunity sounds good to you, send us your resume!

description:
About the job

It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing!

NEOGEN Digital Marketing Analyst support our LATAM digital marketing team. The responsibilities will include social media management for our LATAM accounts, it is Facebook, LinkedIn, and Instagram; execute campaign strategies and create marketing digital assets as email templates, forms, and landing pages on Eloqua (marketing automation), SEO, website optimization and maintenance. This role will also be responsible for assign new leads to sales representant on Salesforce CRM; collect and analyze data from social media, google and Eloqua for digital reports.

The Marketing Automation Specialist is responsible for creating and developing content for forms, landing pages, and email templates within Eloqua, supporting website design, development, and planning, and executing marketing campaigns across multiple digital channels. This role manages lead generation and lead routing processes, supports content ecosystem administration through platforms such as Bynder and Seismic, and monitors marketing KPIs and campaign performance to optimize results.

The position requires maintaining consistency and compliance with brand guidelines, messaging, and approved materials, using only content validated by marketing, technical, and legal stakeholders to ensure traceability and compliance. The incumbent is also responsible for keeping Quality Management System (QMS) documentation up to date, contributing to preventive actions and continuous process improvements, and maintaining an organized and compliant work environment.

In alignment with Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) standards, the employee is expected to use all applicable personal and collective protective equipment, maintain an appropriate workstation, take active breaks, and manage workloads to support personal health and performance.

The successful candidate demonstrates and embodies Neogen's Pillars of Trust—Openness, Honesty, Credibility, Respect, and Service—through all actions, behaviors, and communications. They communicate effectively, actively listen, lead by example, foster teamwork and trust, make timely decisions, solve problems efficiently, and drive performance through accountability, productivity, and innovation. They also understand their role within the broader organization and remain curious about how their work contributes to business success.

Qualifications include a college degree, preferably a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, with at least one year of relevant experience (two years preferred). Candidates should possess knowledge of marketing principles, Microsoft Office applications, CRM systems, and marketing automation platforms, with experience in Eloqua and Salesforce preferred. Additional expertise in digital marketing, Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics, UX/UI design, SEO, SEM, marketing analytics, business intelligence tools, and reporting is highly desirable. An intermediate to advanced level of English is required.

Come Be Part Of A Mission that Matters!

From inside the farm gate to our dinner plates, Neogen protects the world’s food supply. Through a variety of animal healthcare products, to food safety solutions for dangerous bacteria, allergens, toxins, drug residues and much more, Neogen is there — and you can be too.

description:
About the job

About Klar

Let’s start with the basics! Klar is a Mexican fintech whose mission is to democratize and revolutionize how financial services are delivered in Mexico — especially since half of the population still doesn’t have a bank account. Since our launch in 2019, we’ve served more than 7 million users with a growing suite of debit and credit products, and the future is brighter than ever.

Today, we’re not only scaling our consumer business, but also building Klar Empresas (B2B) from the ground up — a new division focused on empowering Mexican SMEs with the financial tools, capital, and services they need to grow. This is an exciting new chapter where we get to design and build from scratch while leveraging the trust and scale of Klar’s platform.

We are also proud to have been certified as a “Great Place to Work” in Mexico — something we’ve worked hard to achieve and will continue to build on.

Our people

If you join us at Klar, you’ll be welcomed to a team which is rich in many talents and we are very proud! With our head office in Mexico City, and remote tech hubs in Berlin and Argentina, we are always learning something new about another culture or language. With so many people from different backgrounds and walks of life (young professionals, parents, LGBTQ+, neurodivergence), you’ll definitely find your people here!

Our values


Ownership - We own our successes & our failures as a team.
Excellence - We do everything to the best of our ability & always seek to achieve a new level of excellence in our work.
Inclusion - We believe we are stronger together and actively work to promote a safe, diverse, inclusive, and respectful culture.
Customer Obsession - We understand the value Klar can bring to its customers & it’s always at the forefront of our decisions.
Klarity - We communicate clearly & with authenticity. It’s in our name & it’s what we do.


The position and your daily adventures

We’re looking for a Performance Marketing Specialist to execute, optimize, and scale paid acquisition campaigns across Google, Meta, and other performance platforms. This is a hands-on role for someone who loves data, experimentation, and turning budgets into measurable growth.

You will own the day-to-day operation of performance campaigns, continuously improving CAC, ROAS, and funnel conversion, working closely with creative, analytics, and growth teams. You’ll be part of a high-performance team managing a US$2M+ monthly budget.

What you can expect:


Reporting: Create weekly and ad-hoc performance reports. Make financial analysis of campaign spend.
Own campaign tracking, attribution setup, and pixel/event health.
Operate and optimize paid campaigns: Constant monitoring and daily adjustments of paid ads campaigns on Google, Facebook and new channels.
Launch new campaigns, ad sets, creatives, and targeting strategies
Monitor performance daily and implement data-driven optimizations.
Run A/B tests on creatives, audiences, landing pages, and funnels.
Collaborate with creative and product teams to improve conversion.
KEY KPIs: New users and approved credit lines, Cost per Acquisition (CpA), and ROAS. 


What we are looking for:


Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Engineering, Digital Transformation Engineering, (or similar) with an orientation to data analysis.
2+ years hands-on experience running performance campaigns on: Meta and Google.
Strong analytical skills, comfort working with performance dashboards and experience with SQL.
Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and attribution tools.
Ability to do Data-driven decision-making.
High ownership, attention to detail, and execution speed.
Advanced English level.
Experience in fintech, apps, or subscription products is a plus.


Our offer to you:


Competitive salary based on performance and experience
Chance of earning Klar stock options
15 days of paid vacation per year; plus extended maternity and paternity leaves
Vacation premium
Food vouchers
30 days of Christmas bonus
Medical Insurance
Computer devices
Well hub subscription to offer mental and physical health 
Sponsored coaching and therapy sessions 
A modern centrally located office in Mexico City with free drinks, snacks, and regular social events
International work environment with amazing and highly skilled people
A world-class team that helps you evolve your skills in areas you're interested in


Klar is a safe place for everyone!

We trust our highly skilled and diverse team, and we’re committed to creating a welcoming and inclusive environment for new talents to flourish. We value diversity and welcome all applications regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, physical abilities, age, sexual orientation and identity.

Should you require any accommodations through the recruitment process, please don’t hesitate to let us know how we can help!

description:
About the job

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced, technically sharp marketing lead for Shopify's 3P Shop Campaigns program. You will own performance, experimentation, and scaling of our Google product advertising portfolio (Performance Max, Shopping, Search Ads), with the opportunity to expand into additional emerging channels over time.

This is not a typical paid media role. You will operate at the intersection of marketing, product feeds, and engineering. A significant part of your work involves managing campaigns with aggressive ROAS targets and expanding the product catalog that powers our ads: millions of merchant products flowing through feed pipelines, eligibility filters, and Google review processes. You will partner closely with engineering and data science teams on catalog health, conversion signal infrastructure, and measurement rigor.

The right person combines hands-on feed/shopping campaign experience with the strategic ability to manage a channel portfolio against efficiency targets, design high-velocity experiments, and communicate performance and trade-offs clearly to leadership.

Why Join Us

You’ll be part of a collaborative Growth team that values creativity, experimentation, and impact. With access to significant budgets, a strong data-driven culture, and exposure to cross-functional experts, you’ll have the opportunity to accelerate your performance media craft, while directly contributing to scaling our business.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio & Campaign Management


Own day-to-day operations of our Google product advertising program (Performance Max, Shopping, Search Ads & more), managing campaigns against revenue ratio and efficiency targets globally.
Design and execute high-velocity testing pipelines across bidding strategies, campaign structures, audiences, creative, and landing pages.
Over time, extend ownership to additional emerging channels as the portfolio evolves, managing a tiered channel strategy with structured experiments and clear kill criteria.



Catalog & Feed Management


Own the health and growth of the product catalog that powers all advertising: eligibility rules, feed quality, Google Merchant Center policies, and disapproval resolution.
Monitor catalog coverage and identify scaling levers, including eligibility filter tuning, MCA suspension reduction, and feed enrichment opportunities.
Partner with product and engineering teams on catalog pipeline improvements and product vetting automation.



Conversion Signals & Measurement


Partner with engineering to maintain and improve conversion signal pipelines, ensuring signal quality, match rates, and attribution accuracy.
Work with data science on incrementality measurement, attribution model calibration, and valuation frameworks that inform spend allocation decisions.
Monitor signal health (click ID coverage, event volumes, platform-reported vs. internal attribution gaps) and escalate anomalies.



Cross-Functional & Communication


Work with creative strategy to develop effective product advertising programs across the funnel.
Actively communicate program performance, financial health, and strategic trade-offs to marketing leadership and finance stakeholders.



Qualifications


A successful track record managing SEM and product-feed-based advertising campaigns at scale (Shopping, Performance Max, or equivalent), with demonstrated ability to hit efficiency targets.
Direct experience with product feed management and merchant center operations: feed diagnostics, disapproval resolution, eligibility optimization, and catalog scaling.
Experience with SQL. You may not be able to write complex queries from scratch, but you have a high-level understanding of databases and how to query them.
Working knowledge of conversion tracking infrastructure: server-to-server signals, click ID mechanics, attribution windows, and how signal quality affects platform bidding.
Experience partnering with engineering and data science teams on technical marketing problems (feed pipelines, attribution, measurement frameworks).
Ability to design structured experiments with clear hypotheses, kill criteria, and measurement plans.
Strong stakeholder communication skills: you can translate technical performance data into clear narratives for marketing leadership and finance.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and can navigate through ambiguity and work with minimal guidance.



About Shopify

Opportunity is not evenly distributed. Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business. We propel entrepreneurs and enterprises to scale the heights of their potential. Since 2006, we’ve grown to over 8,300 employees and generated over $1 trillion in sales for millions of merchants in 175 countries.

This is life-defining work that directly impacts people’s lives as much as it transforms your own. This is putting the power of the few in the hands of the many, is a future with more voices rather than fewer, and is creating more choices instead of an elite option.

About You

Moving at our pace brings a lot of change, complexity, and ambiguity—and a little bit of chaos. Shopifolk thrive on that and are comfortable being uncomfortable. That means Shopify is not the right place for everyone.

Before you apply, consider if you can:
